meta.label: Player value (finishing, creation, faceoffs, penalties, defence) - a display rating; the game model does not use it yet (forward test on 2026-27 pending)
meta.game_level: locked TEST: log loss improved by 0.00062 (0.66418 -> 0.66356), n.s., 95% CI -0.00066 to +0.00188 (data/nhl_test_ledger.csv row 11); forward test pre-registered: data/pv_nhl_forward_prereg_2026_27.json
meta.state: each skater's most recent walk-forward state = his rating going into his last game on file (pre-game; that game is not folded in)

units.v: goals per 60 of all-situations ice time vs an average regular at his position
units.g: goals per game at his usual ice time
units.o: offence: cre + fin + a1 + a2 + pp contributions, goals per 60
units.qo: percentile of o within F / D (reference regulars)
units.prov: 1 = provisional: fewer than 82 NHL games on file (gp)
units.c: component contributions to v, goals per 60; they sum to v (def at the display weight, meta.display_weights)
units.fm: finishing multiplier exp(fin_mu): goals per expected goal vs average
units.fo: [win probability vs an average taker, faceoffs / 60] (takers only)
units.pen: [goals / 60 drawn minus taken, penalties drawn / 60, taken / 60]
units.def: 5v5 on-ice xG / 60 prevented (RAPM; null = never had a fit)
units.toi: expected minutes per game, all situations
units.gp: NHL games on file before this state (2010-11 on)
units.sgp: regular-season games in his last season

components.fin: Finishing: goals above expected per 60 at 5v5 (1v1 shooter-vs-goalie rating)
components.pp: Power play: own PP expected goals x finishing, plus PP assists
components.fo: Faceoffs: 1v1 rating (win probability vs an average taker), valued in goals
components.pen: Penalties drawn minus taken, valued in goals
components.def: Defence: on-ice xG-against impact (RAPM), xG/60 prevented at 5v5

meta.display_note: The display counts on-ice defence at 1 goal per expected goal prevented (the structural prior); the game-prediction fit uses 1.90, which at lineup level absorbs team signal. Every other component keeps its fit weight, and every value is first recomputed with the fit weights and checked against the validated pipeline. Same-season on-ice goal differential per 60 agrees best at 1.0 for forwards and defencemen (descriptive, not a model test).

def_reliability.kind: year-over-year correlation of single-season fits, DEV seasons 2010-18
def_reliability.window: the displayed defence is a multi-season on-ice fit: 4 seasons (his current one and the 3 before, refit monthly), 730-day half-life, adjusted for teammates and opponents

meta.shift_gap: Shift charts are complete for every 2024-25 and 2025-26 game on file (repaired 2026-09-25: 525 games from the repopulated NHL shift-chart API and 57 from the official HTML time-on-ice reports); the values use every game.
